tabS9_tier0 <- map_dfr(DATASET_ORDER, function(ds) {
  ty <- COVARIATE_TYPES[[ds]]
  vars <- names(ty)[unlist(ty) %in% c("binary", "categorical")]
  map_dfr(vars, function(v) {
    dom <- CLIPPING_BOUNDS_FIXED[[ds]][[v]]
    tibble(
      dataset = ds, variable = v, tier = 0L,
      rule = if (ty[[v]] == "binary")
               "Domain of the coding convention (binary; support of the randomized response)"
             else
               paste("Domain of the coding convention (category set;",
                     "support of the categorical randomized response)"),
      domain = paste0("{", paste(dom, collapse = ", "), "}"),
      unit_data = ty[[v]], source_value = paste(dom, collapse = ", "),
      unit_source = ty[[v]], conversion = "None",
      source_citation = TIER0_SOURCE[[ds]], source_url = TIER0_URL,
      access_date = "2026-08-25", obs_ref = OBS_REF_NONE)
  })
})
stopifnot(nrow(tabS9_tier0) == 24)

tabS9 <- bind_rows(tabS9_tier0, tabS9_cont) %>%
  mutate(dataset = factor(dataset, levels = DATASET_ORDER)) %>%
  arrange(dataset, tier, variable) %>%
  mutate(dataset = as.character(dataset))

n_cov <- sum(vapply(DATASET_ORDER, function(d) length(COVARIATE_TYPES[[d]]), integer(1)))
stopifnot(nrow(tabS9) == n_cov, n_cov == 51,
          !any(duplicated(paste(tabS9$dataset, tabS9$variable))),
          all(tabS9$obs_ref == OBS_REF_NONE))

local({
  cjk  <- "[\u3000-\u30ff\u4e00-\u9fff\uff00-\uffef]"
  cols <- c("dataset", "variable", "rule", "domain", "unit_data", "source_value",
            "unit_source", "conversion", "source_citation", "source_url", "access_date",
            "obs_ref")
  stopifnot(all(cols %in% names(tabS9)))
  bad <- Filter(function(cc) any(grepl(cjk, tabS9[[cc]], perl = TRUE)), cols)
  if (length(bad))
    stop("Table S9 still contains Japanese in: ", paste(bad, collapse = ", "),
         ". Translate FIXED_BOUNDS_SOURCES in main/02_dp_mechanisms/R/dp_bounds_comparison.R, ",
         "re-write data/03_simulation/phase1_bounds_fixed/tabS9_fixed_bounds_draft.csv from it, ",
         "and translate the Tier 0 block above.", call. = FALSE)
  cat("Table S9: no CJK character in any of the", length(cols), "shipped columns, all",
      nrow(tabS9), "rows.\n")
})

save_tbl(tabS9, "tabS9_fixed_bounds", digits = 0)

kable(tabS9 %>% select(dataset, variable, tier, rule, domain, source_value, unit_source,
                       conversion, obs_ref),
      caption = sprintf("Experiment C: derivation of every fixed bound (%d covariates: %d in Tier 0 = coding conventions, %d continuous in Tiers 1--5). The `obs\\_ref` column records whether the observed data were consulted; it is \"no reference\" for every row.",
                        nrow(tabS9), nrow(tabS9_tier0), nrow(tabS9_cont)),
      booktabs = TRUE, linesep = "") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"),
                full_width = FALSE, font_size = 9) %>%
  scroll_box(width = "100%", height = "460px")

kable(tabS9 %>% count(tier, name = "n"),
      caption = "Rows per tier of evidence.") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "striped", full_width = FALSE)
```

```{r expc-checks}
inf_id <- read.csv(file.path(SIM_DIR, "phase1_bounds_fixed/inf_identity_production.csv"),
                   stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
kable(inf_id, digits = 10,
      caption = "At $\\varepsilon = \\infty$ the mechanism only clips, so the arms may differ only where a bound actually cuts the data.") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "striped", full_width = FALSE)

expc_cfr <- expc_raw %>%
  distinct(arm, dataset, epsilon, iteration, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  group_by(arm, dataset, epsilon) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), fail = sum(!converged), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(fail > 0) %>%
  mutate(cfr_pct = 100 * fail / n) %>%
  arrange(desc(cfr_pct))
kable(expc_cfr, digits = 3,
      caption = "Conditions with any non-converged iteration (all three arms).") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "striped", full_width = FALSE)
cat(sprintf("Overall CFR across the three arms: %.4f%%\n",
            100 * sum(expc_cfr$fail) /
              nrow(expc_raw %>% distinct(arm, dataset, epsilon, iteration))))

```{r expg-load}
EXPG_DIR <- EVAL_DIR
expg_design <- read.csv(file.path(EXPG_DIR, "exp_g_pilot_flchain_design.csv"),
                        stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
expg_fixed  <- read.csv(file.path(EXPG_DIR, "exp_g_pilot_flchain_fixedlam.csv"),
                        stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
expg_comp   <- read.csv(file.path(EXPG_DIR, "exp_g_pilot_flchain_compare.csv"),
                        stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
stopifnot(nrow(expg_design) == 1)
EXPG_SPECS <- c("formal_q200", "datadriven_K13", "datadriven_q200", "formal_K13")
stopifnot(identical(strsplit(expg_design$specs, "|", fixed = TRUE)[[1]], EXPG_SPECS),
          setequal(unique(expg_fixed$spec), EXPG_SPECS))
EXPG_REF_C_K13 <- expg_design$ref_c_nonprivate_formal_K13

EXPG_REF_C  <- expg_design$ref_c_nonprivate
EXPG_LAMBDA <- expg_design$lambda_fixed

kable(expg_design %>%
        select(`non-private C (test)` = ref_c_nonprivate, `Lambda (fixed)` = lambda_fixed,
               `q` = q_intervals, `t_max (days)` = t_max_days, B, `run date` = run_date),
      digits = 4,
      caption = "Experiment G: design constants read from the run that produced the figures (not transcribed).") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "striped", full_width = FALSE)

```{r fig-exp-g, fig.cap="Out-of-sample C-index on flchain for the four approaches of this work (dashed lines) and four specifications of Nguyen \\& Hui's Algorithm 1 (solid lines), over the same B=1000 Monte-Carlo train/test splits. The line type separates the two families and does not encode the guarantee; whether a specification carries a formal DP guarantee end to end is written in its legend label. The two formal specifications use equal-width intervals on the fixed 5,223-day horizon (200 and 13 intervals) and share every normalization constant. The data-dependent-normalization specification shares the 200-interval grid and the time normalization with the formal one and differs only in computing the covariate normalization from the training data; the customary implementation uses 13 quantile intervals and training-data normalization. The upper grey line is the non-private test C-index and the lower one is random prediction.", fig.width=10, fig.height=7.4}
expg_all <- expg_comp %>%
  filter(is.finite(epsilon)) %>%
  mutate(arm = factor(arm, levels = c(
           "Phase 1", "Phase 2", "Phase 3",
           "Out (Laplace)", "Out (std)", "Out (dfbeta)",
           "Nguyen Alg.1 (v2, 非 formal)",
           "Nguyen Alg.1 (data-dependent normalisation only, q=200)",
           "Nguyen Alg.1 (formal, q=200)",
           "Nguyen Alg.1 (formal, K=13)")))
stopifnot(!any(is.na(expg_all$arm)),
          nlevels(droplevels(expg_all$arm)) == 10L - !("Out (Laplace)" %in% expg_all$arm))

EXPG_DROPPED <- c("Out (Laplace)", "Out (std)")
EXPG_NGUYEN  <- c("Nguyen Alg.1 (formal, q=200)",
                  "Nguyen Alg.1 (formal, K=13)",
                  "Nguyen Alg.1 (data-dependent normalisation only, q=200)",
                  "Nguyen Alg.1 (v2, 非 formal)")
EXPG_OURS    <- c("Phase 1", "Phase 2", "Phase 3", "Out (dfbeta)")
expg_plot <- expg_all %>% filter(!arm %in% EXPG_DROPPED) %>% mutate(arm = droplevels(arm))
stopifnot(setequal(levels(expg_plot$arm), c(EXPG_NGUYEN, EXPG_OURS)),
          nlevels(expg_plot$arm) == 8L,
          nrow(expg_plot) == 8L * 14L,
          identical(expg_plot$c_test, expg_all$c_test[!expg_all$arm %in% EXPG_DROPPED]))

EXPG_COLORS <- c(
  "Phase 1" = "#0072B2", "Phase 2" = "#E69F00", "Phase 3" = "#009E73",
  "Out (dfbeta)" = "#D55E00",
  "Nguyen Alg.1 (v2, 非 formal)" = "#8C6D31",
  "Nguyen Alg.1 (data-dependent normalisation only, q=200)" = "#CC79A7",
  "Nguyen Alg.1 (formal, q=200)" = "#000000",
  "Nguyen Alg.1 (formal, K=13)" = "#B22222")
EXPG_LABELS <- c(
  "Nguyen Alg.1 (formal, q=200)" = "Nguyen Alg. 1, formal (200 intervals)",
  "Nguyen Alg.1 (formal, K=13)" = "Nguyen Alg. 1, formal (13 intervals)",
  "Nguyen Alg.1 (data-dependent normalisation only, q=200)" = "Nguyen Alg. 1, data-dependent normalization (200 intervals)",
  "Nguyen Alg.1 (v2, 非 formal)" = "Nguyen Alg. 1, customary (13 quantile intervals)",
  "Phase 1" = "Phase 1", "Phase 2" = "Phase 2", "Phase 3" = "Phase 3",
  "Out (dfbeta)" = "Output (dfbeta)")
EXPG_LINETYPES <- c(setNames(rep("solid", 4), EXPG_NGUYEN), setNames(rep("22", 4), EXPG_OURS))
EXPG_LEGEND_ORDER <- c(EXPG_NGUYEN, EXPG_OURS)
stopifnot(setequal(names(EXPG_COLORS), levels(expg_plot$arm)),
          setequal(names(EXPG_LABELS), levels(expg_plot$arm)),
          setequal(names(EXPG_LINETYPES), levels(expg_plot$arm)),
          !any(grepl("q *= *200|K *= *13", EXPG_LABELS)))

p_expg <- ggplot(expg_plot, aes(epsilon, c_test, colour = arm, linetype = arm)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.5, linetype = "dotted", colour = "grey45", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = EXPG_REF_C, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey30", linewidth = 0.4) +
  annotate("text", x = 0.1, y = EXPG_REF_C + 0.012, hjust = 0, size = 3, colour = "grey25",
           label = sprintf("non-private = %.3f", EXPG_REF_C)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.75) +
  geom_point(size = 1.5) +
  scale_x_log10(breaks = c(0.1, 1, 10, 100, 1000),
                labels = c("0.1", "1", "10", "100", "1000")) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = EXPG_COLORS, labels = EXPG_LABELS, breaks = EXPG_LEGEND_ORDER, name = NULL) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = EXPG_LINETYPES, labels = EXPG_LABELS, breaks = EXPG_LEGEND_ORDER, name = NULL) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0.45, 0.82)) +
  labs(x = expression(paste("Privacy budget ", epsilon, " (log scale)")),
       y = "Out-of-sample C-index (test)") +
  theme_paper() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.margin = margin(t = 0, b = 0), legend.spacing.y = unit(2, "pt"),
        legend.key.width = unit(2.2, "lines"),
        legend.text = element_text(size = rel(0.85))) +
  guides(colour = guide_legend(ncol = 2, byrow = FALSE),
         linetype = guide_legend(ncol = 2, byrow = FALSE))
p_expg
save_fig(p_expg, "fig6_exp_g", width = 10, height = 7.4)

```{r tab-exp-g}
EPS_SHOW_G <- c(0.1, 0.5, 1, 5, 10, 30, Inf)
expg_gap <- expg_fixed %>%
  filter(epsilon %in% EPS_SHOW_G) %>%
  select(spec, epsilon, c_test) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = spec, values_from = c_test) %>%
  mutate(`price of the guarantee` = datadriven_q200 - formal_q200,
         `gap to non-private` = EXPG_REF_C - formal_q200) %>%
  arrange(epsilon) %>%
  select(epsilon,
         `data-dependent normalization only (not formal)` = datadriven_q200,
         `fully data-independent (formal)` = formal_q200,
         `price of the guarantee`, `gap to non-private`,
         `customary implementation (K = 13, not formal)` = datadriven_K13,
         `fully data-independent (formal, K = 13)` = formal_K13) %>%
  mutate(epsilon = ifelse(is.infinite(epsilon), "Inf", as.character(epsilon)))
stopifnot(nrow(expg_gap) == length(EPS_SHOW_G), !anyNA(expg_gap), ncol(expg_gap) == 7L)

save_tbl(as.data.frame(expg_gap), "tabS10_exp_g", digits = 4)

kable(expg_gap, digits = 4,
      caption = sprintf("Experiment G on flchain at $\\Lambda = %g$ fixed in advance, B = %d. \"Price of the guarantee\" is the test C-index that the specification whose covariate normalization is computed from the training data gains over the fully data-independent specification; the two share the interval grid (200 equal-width intervals on a fixed 5,223-day horizon) and the time normalization, so the difference isolates the normalization. \"Gap to non-private\" is what the formal arm gives up in total against the unregularised fit (%.4f). The sixth column is the customary implementation (K = 13 quantile intervals, training-data normalization), which differs from the formal arm in the interval grid as well and is shown for reference only. The last column is the fully data-independent specification with 13 equal-width intervals on the same fixed horizon and the same normalization as the 200-interval formal arm; its non-private reference is %.4f.",
                        EXPG_LAMBDA, expg_design$B, EXPG_REF_C, EXPG_REF_C_K13),
      booktabs = TRUE, linesep = "") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"), full_width = FALSE)

g_prac <- expg_gap %>% filter(epsilon %in% c("0.5", "1"))
g_inf  <- expg_gap %>% filter(epsilon == "Inf")
cat(sprintf("Price of the guarantee (normalization only): %.4f at eps=0.5, %.4f at eps=1, %.4f with the noise removed (eps=Inf).\n",
            g_prac$`price of the guarantee`[g_prac$epsilon == "0.5"],
            g_prac$`price of the guarantee`[g_prac$epsilon == "1"],
            g_inf$`price of the guarantee`))
expg_all <- expg_fixed %>% select(spec, epsilon, c_test) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = spec, values_from = c_test) %>%
  mutate(price = datadriven_q200 - formal_q200)
cat(sprintf("Over the practical range eps = 1..10 the price runs from %.4f to %.4f; the former definition (K = 13 minus formal) ran from %.4f to %.4f.\n",
            min(expg_all$price[expg_all$epsilon >= 1 & expg_all$epsilon <= 10]),
            max(expg_all$price[expg_all$epsilon >= 1 & expg_all$epsilon <= 10]),
            min((expg_all$datadriven_K13 - expg_all$formal_q200)[expg_all$epsilon >= 1 & expg_all$epsilon <= 10]),
            max((expg_all$datadriven_K13 - expg_all$formal_q200)[expg_all$epsilon >= 1 & expg_all$epsilon <= 10])))
k13 <- expg_all %>% mutate(d_k13 = formal_K13 - formal_q200)
cat(sprintf("formal_K13 minus formal_q200 (interval count only, guarantee kept): %+.4f at eps=1, %+.4f at eps=10, %+.4f at eps=Inf; formal_K13 gap to its own non-private reference %.4f at eps=1.\n",
            k13$d_k13[k13$epsilon == 1], k13$d_k13[k13$epsilon == 10], k13$d_k13[is.infinite(k13$epsilon)],
            EXPG_REF_C_K13 - k13$formal_K13[k13$epsilon == 1]))
cat(sprintf("The formal arm tops out at %.4f against a non-private %.4f (gap %.4f).\n",
            expg_fixed$c_test[expg_fixed$spec == "formal_q200" & is.infinite(expg_fixed$epsilon)],
            EXPG_REF_C,
            EXPG_REF_C - expg_fixed$c_test[expg_fixed$spec == "formal_q200" &
                                             is.infinite(expg_fixed$epsilon)]))
```

```{r tab-phase3-exclusion}
th_path <- file.path(EVAL_DIR, "phase3_exclusion_thresholds.csv")
stopifnot(file.exists(th_path))
tabS12 <- read.csv(th_path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE) %>%
  rename(arm = アーム, threshold = 閾値,
         submitted = `投稿版（除外あり）`, no_exclusion = `除外なし`,
         self_referential = `自己参照ベースライン`) %>%
  mutate(threshold = recode(threshold,
                            eps_lsr50 = "eps*_{LSR<=0.50}",
                            eps_lsr10 = "eps*_{LSR<=0.10}",
                            eps_fpr10 = "eps*_{FPR<=0.10}"),
         same_without_exclusion = submitted == no_exclusion,
         same_self_referential  = submitted == self_referential) %>%
  select(arm, dataset, threshold, submitted, no_exclusion, self_referential,
         same_without_exclusion, same_self_referential)

TABS12_THRESHOLD_TEX <- c(
  "eps*_{LSR<=0.50}" = "$\\varepsilon^{*}_{\\mathrm{LSR} \\leq 0.50}$",
  "eps*_{LSR<=0.10}" = "$\\varepsilon^{*}_{\\mathrm{LSR} \\leq 0.10}$",
  "eps*_{FPR<=0.10}" = "$\\varepsilon^{*}_{\\mathrm{FPR} \\leq 0.10}$")
save_tbl(as.data.frame(tabS12), "tabS12_phase3_exclusion", digits = 0,
         sanitize_text = identity,
         tex_transform = function(d) {
           stopifnot(all(d$threshold %in% names(TABS12_THRESHOLD_TEX)))
           d$threshold <- unname(TABS12_THRESHOLD_TEX[d$threshold])
           for (cl in c("submitted", "no_exclusion", "self_referential"))
             d[[cl]] <- ifelse(d[[cl]] == "> 1000", "$>$ 1000", d[[cl]])
           stopifnot(!any(grepl("[<>]", unlist(d[c("arm", "dataset", "submitted", "no_exclusion", "self_referential")])) &
                          !grepl("\\$[<>]\\$", unlist(d[c("arm", "dataset", "submitted", "no_exclusion", "self_referential")]))))
           d
         })

kable(tabS12,
      caption = "Experiment H-2: the published $\\varepsilon^{*}$ thresholds for Phase 3 under three treatments of the two/one discordant coefficients. `no\\_exclusion` keeps them in the denominator; `self\\_referential` replaces the Cox baseline by Phase 3's own $\\varepsilon = \\infty$ output and needs no exclusion at all.",
      booktabs = TRUE, linesep = "") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"),
                full_width = FALSE, font_size = 10) %>%
  scroll_box(width = "100%", height = "420px")

cat(sprintf("Thresholds unchanged when the exclusion is dropped: %d / %d\n",
            sum(tabS12$same_without_exclusion), nrow(tabS12)))
cat(sprintf("Thresholds reproduced by the self-referential baseline: %d / %d\n",
            sum(tabS12$same_self_referential), nrow(tabS12)))
stopifnot(nrow(tabS12) == 30)
